tagline.zh: 叠在内容之上的半透明平铺文字层:低透明度、轻微负角度、按 gap 重复铺满,用于防泄露威慑与归属溯源,而不妨碍阅读。
tagline.en: A translucent tiled text layer over content: low opacity, a slight negative angle, repeated at a gap — a deterrent and provenance trail that never obstructs reading.

origin.zh: Ant Design 官方 Watermark 组件:canvas 绘制单格图案作 background-image 平铺,默认 rotate -22°、gap [100,100]、单格 120×64、font rgba(0,0,0,.15)·16px·sans-serif、zIndex 9,并内置 MutationObserver 防篡改(06-antdesign §4.24,6.7.1 源码核对);TDesign 以 token 形式提供水印文字色 --td-text-color-watermark rgba(0,0,0,10%)(02-tdesign §1.6,一手 _light.less)。
origin.en: Ant Design's official Watermark component: a canvas-drawn tile repeated as a background-image, with defaults rotate -22°, gap [100,100], tile 120×64, font rgba(0,0,0,.15)·16px·sans-serif, zIndex 9, plus a built-in MutationObserver anti-tamper (06-antdesign §4.24, verified against 6.7.1 source); TDesign ships a watermark text token --td-text-color-watermark rgba(0,0,0,10%) (02-tdesign §1.6, first-hand _light.less).

effect.zh: 水印文字内容。antd 的 content 为任意 string/数组(6.5.0 起支持逐行 font),image 可传入 2x/3x 图且优先级更高;此三档是 demo 的预设文案(编辑性选择,非官方默认)。用户标识档对应企业文档『访客姓名水印』的典型生产用法。
effect.en: The watermark text. antd's content accepts any string/array (per-line font since 6.5.0), and image takes a 2x/3x graphic with higher priority; these three presets are demo copy (an editorial choice, not an official default). The user-identity tier mirrors the typical production pattern of per-visitor name watermarks on enterprise docs.

effect.zh: 单个水印字样的旋转角(度)。默认 -22 取自 antd Watermark 的 rotate 官方默认值(06-antdesign §4.24 核对);负角度是行业惯例——与正文水平基线错开又不至于倒置难读。
effect.en: Rotation of a single watermark tile, in degrees. Default -22 is antd Watermark's official rotate default (06-antdesign §4.24); a negative angle is the industry convention — offset from the text baseline without flipping it upside down.

effect.zh: 水印层整体不透明度。默认 0.15 对齐 antd font.color 默认 rgba(0,0,0,.15) 的 alpha 通道;TDesign 水印文字色 rgba(0,0,0,10%) 是同一带内更收敛的一档(02-tdesign §1.6)。
effect.en: Overall opacity of the watermark layer. Default 0.15 matches the alpha of antd's default font color rgba(0,0,0,.15); TDesign's watermark text color rgba(0,0,0,10%) sits one notch lower in the same band (02-tdesign §1.6).

effect.zh: 相邻水印格之间的间距。antd gap 默认 [100, 100](横纵同值),demo 取单一正值同时作用于两轴;与单格尺寸(antd 默认 120×64)共同决定平铺密度。
effect.en: Spacing between adjacent watermark tiles. antd's gap defaults to [100, 100] (equal on both axes); the demo uses one positive value for both axes. Together with the tile size (antd default 120×64) it sets the tiling density.

note.zh: demo 采用 DOM 瓦片 + CSS Grid 平铺,antd 官方采用 canvas.toDataURL 作 background-image 重复——两者都是多年基线能力,现代浏览器全支持;本条目不涉及 backdrop-filter 一类的新特性门槛。antd 另以 5.18.0 起容器强制 overflow:hidden 防高度归零。
note.en: The demo tiles DOM spans via CSS Grid; antd's official path repeats a canvas.toDataURL as a background-image — both are long-established baseline capabilities supported by all current browsers; this entry has no backdrop-filter-class feature gate. antd additionally forces overflow:hidden on the container since 5.18.0 to prevent height collapse.

fallback.zh: CSS 瓦片方案:不支持 Grid 的极老浏览器退化为整层单条居中水印(功能仍在);transform 缺失时字样不倾斜但不丢防护。canvas 方案:dataURL 生成失败时回退为无水印或单条文字层;位图在高 DPI 屏需 2x 采样避免发虚。
fallback.en: CSS tiling: on ancient browsers without Grid it degrades to one centered text strip (protection intact); without transform the tiles stay horizontal but the layer still works. Canvas: if the dataURL fails, fall back to no watermark or a single text strip; bitmap tiles need 2x sampling on high-DPI screens to avoid blur.

use.zh: 企业内部系统/管理后台的内容区防泄露——常见『访客姓名 + 工号 + 时间』标识档
use.en: Leak deterrence on internal systems/admin consoles — the typical 'visitor name + ID + time' identity tier

use.zh: 在线文档/知识库的只读分享视图,标注归属与访问者,截图外传可溯源
use.en: Read-only sharing views of docs/wikis — mark ownership and the visitor so leaked screenshots are traceable

use.zh: 图库/素材站的付费预览图防盗用(logo 平铺,密度通常高于文档场景)
use.en: Paid preview images on stock-asset sites (tiled logo, usually denser than document scenarios)

use.zh: 证书/凭据/报告类页面的归属标识(产品名档)
use.en: Ownership marks on certificates/credentials/reports (the product-name tier)

avoid.zh: 正文密集阅读区叠加高透明度水印——正文对比度被稀释,可读性崩坏
avoid.en: Dense reading areas under a heavy watermark — body contrast is diluted and readability collapses

avoid.zh: 用水印替代权限控制——水印是威慑与溯源手段,不是访问控制
avoid.en: Using a watermark in place of access control — watermarks deter and trace, they do not authorize

avoid.zh: 水印层拦截交互——必须 pointer-events:none,不得遮挡点击、选择与焦点
avoid.en: Letting the watermark layer intercept input — it must be pointer-events:none and never block clicks, selection or focus

avoid.zh: 大面积 canvas 高频重绘——每次参数变化都重绘编码,代价集中在主线程
avoid.en: Frequent canvas redraws over large areas — every change re-rasterizes and re-encodes on the main thread

a11y.zh: 水印层必须 aria-hidden(纯装饰,不承载必读信息)且 pointer-events:none(不拦截焦点与读屏顺序);水印不得使正文对比度跌破 4.5:1(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3)——opacity 上限 0.2 的取值带即为此服务;关键信息必须在无水印时仍完整可读,移除水印不得破坏页面完整性。
a11y.en: The watermark layer must be aria-hidden (purely decorative, carrying no required information) and pointer-events:none (never intercepting focus or reading order); it must not push body-text contrast below 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3) — the 0.2 opacity ceiling exists for exactly this; all key information must remain fully readable without the watermark, and removing it must not break the page.

goal.zh: 在内容卡上复刻平铺水印:半透明文字按 -22° 重复铺满整个内容区,密度由 gap 控制,zIndex 低于弹层体系,pointer-events:none 不拦截交互。
goal.en: Replicate a tiled watermark over a content card: translucent text repeated at -22° across the whole content area, density set by the gap, z-index below the overlay system, pointer-events:none so it never intercepts input.

acceptance.zh: rotate/opacity/gap 严格使用参数快照值(默认 -22° / 0.15 / 100px,对齐 antd 官方默认)
acceptance.en: rotate/opacity/gap use the exact parameter snapshot values (defaults -22° / 0.15 / 100px, aligned with antd's official defaults)

acceptance.zh: 单格文字 16px、常规字重、无衬线、居中对齐(antd font 默认),单格 120×64
acceptance.en: Tile text at 16px, regular weight, sans-serif, centered (antd font defaults), tile 120×64

acceptance.zh: 水印层 aria-hidden + pointer-events:none,z-index 不拦截弹层
acceptance.en: The watermark layer is aria-hidden + pointer-events:none; its z-index never blocks overlays

acceptance.zh: 任一参数改动即时重铺,无需刷新页面
acceptance.en: Any parameter change re-tiles instantly without a page reload

acceptance.zh: 暗色场景切换为白色水印文字(TDesign 暗色 token 同思路)
acceptance.en: The dark scene switches watermark text to white (same idea as TDesign's dark token)
